title: 113-115 West Jackson Street (Commercial Building), Elkhart, Elkhart County, IN
notes: Significance: Commercial Building, Ornate exterior.  Part of original downtown district. // c. 1880.  Load bearing masonry walls with interior wood framing.  Roll roofing over wood frame.  Reddish Brown Brick.  Bay window, decorative cornice, arch top windows with "eyebrow" muntins, projected brick arch over windows.  Vacant, fire damages.  Fire set by vagrants during July 1986.
